Hi Serdar -

I'm not quite sure if this answers your exact question, but I think what you want can be done by just installing the packages.  (diamonds is a data set that comes with ggplot2.)

Try this, hopefully everything should run smoothly.

install.packages(c('ggplot2','plyr','reshape','proto'))
library(ggplot2)
head(diamonds)
d_slim <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),1000),]
qplot(carat, price, data = d_slim, colour = cut)

If you see a plot, it worked and you're on your way.

Cheers
david.
